snippet.title: 𝚁𝚞𝚜𝚑𝚊𝚞𝚐®: 𝙵𝚎𝚕𝚒𝚗𝚎 𝚆𝚊𝚛𝚏𝚊𝚛𝚎 -- "𝙰𝚝𝚘𝚖𝚒𝚌 𝚃𝚑𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚝" 𝙶𝚊𝚖𝚎𝚙𝚕𝚊𝚢 𝚃𝚛𝚊𝚒𝚕𝚎𝚛 [𝟸𝟶𝟸𝟺]
snippet.description:
Cats tamed the atom, but not feline nature.

⬇ Wishlist Today ⬇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1462990/Rushaug_Feline_Warfare/

⬇ Links and Info ⬇
Website + FAQ ‣ https://rushaug.com
Developer’s Website ‣ https://tobiasedvardsen.com

⬇ Social Media ⬇
Twitter ‣  https://twitter.com/Edvardsen96
Facebook ‣  https://www.facebook.com/rushaugfelinewarfare
Instagram ‣  https://www.instagram.com/rushaug
Discord ‣  https://discord.gg/ETzhPDn
Reddit ‣   https://www.reddit.com/r/Rushaug/
Twitch ‣  https://www.twitch.tv/tobiasedvardsen


#Rushaug is a tactical platformer combining stealth and fast-paced gunplay with action and story-driven missions in a vast explorable world with a large variety of environments. Infiltrate enemy outposts, prevent nuclear war, and uncover the enemy's top secret weapon; Project Emerald.

- Gameplay Features -

• Choose between 50 weapons to wreak havoc and complete missions in your preferred style
• Deploy into 8 different missions divided into unique environments in large Metroidvania-styled maps
• Complete missions guns blazing, littering the place with explosions and gun powder, or slide through like an assassin without detection and receive a flawless 5-star rating
• Complete objectives in a non-linear fashion, impacting how events unfold throughout the game
• Choose between 4 different operators with each their own abilities:
  - Rushaug: the undisputed master of stealth and sabotage
  - Drake Woods: The heavy weapons specialists who prefers going loud above all silent tactics
  - Rex: The reconnaissance specialist with his drone and planning skills, sometimes exhibiting orange cat behavior
  - Duchess: The swift femme fatale field medic who saves lives as quickly as she ends them.

Subscribe for devlogs, updates, content, and much more!
